# Gormes

Gormes is a local-first Go AI agent runtime for running local or server-side
agents from one static binary with offline diagnostics, SQLite memory, provider
chat, trusted gateways, and optional Navivox mobile pairing.

## Core Positioning

- Go-native AI agent runtime
- Go AI agent runtime
- Local AI agent runtime
- Single binary AI agent
- Offline AI runtime
- AI agent memory
- AI gateway runtime
- Hermes agent alternative
- Android/Termux AI agent runtime

## Current Capabilities

- CLI and offline TUI
- `gormes doctor --offline` before credentials or provider token spend
- Provider-backed chat
- Local SQLite memory and sessions
- Dashboard
- Hermes-style skills and tools in the Go runtime
- Telegram, Discord, and Slack gateways
- Experimental Navivox mobile control app for local or remote Gormes runtimes

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://gormes.ai/install.sh | bash
gormes doctor --offline
gormes setup
gormes chat
```
